title: Robert Hastings: 7 or 8 of 167 nuclear witnesses had close encounters
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robert Hastings: 7 or 8 of 167 nuclear witnesses had close encounters, about 1960s-present at US nuclear sites, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once asked Robert Hastings, the author of a book called UFOs and Nukes, how many of his 167 military witnesses from US nuclear sites had gone beyond seeing strange things and had actually seen beings or been abducted, what researchers call close encounters of the third kind. According to Michels, Hastings answered: about seven or eight of the 167. If true, it would mean a few people guarding America's nuclear weapons say they met non-human beings face to face.
